anomalies.description: Two men engage in a standoff with firearms, escalating to physical confrontation when one is shot and falls; the interaction involves mutual threat and violent resolution.; A violent physical confrontation occurs: after being shot (f4), the man in suspenders is thrown backward (f6–f7), while the shooter is also knocked off balance and falls (f8–f11), indicating mutual forceful interaction or explosive recoil/impact effects.

The bald man in white fires a submachine gun at the man in suspenders; muzzle flash and recoil are visible in frame f4, and the target is shown reacting with arms raised in frame f3 (just before impact) and recoiling in f4–f5.; The bald man in the white shirt fires his submachine gun at the other man; a muzzle flash is visible and the target recoils violently backward, indicating impact.
A bald man in a white coat attacks a man in a white shirt and suspenders, striking him and causing him to fall backward onto the floor.

The man in the white shirt and suspenders, now on the floor, aims and fires a handgun toward an off-screen target; muzzle flash is not visible but the posture, grip, and sustained aim across multiple frames indicate active shooting.
